gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-shippori-antique-: Loud, unfussy letterforms up top, with Bellota Text drawing open curves and no pen shading, while Shippori Antique B1 follows in a modern sans. Both leave daylight in every bend.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-sn-pro: Commanding Bellota Text holds its line width through every curve and straight, giving headings a cut-from-wire look. And SN Pro keeps its sans curves wide open, so paragraphs below stay easy going.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-snippet: Bellota Text brings open, shading-free letters with a distinctive punch, while Snippet's crescent-wrench c gives the sans below a bent-wire friendliness. One shouts a headline; the other talks.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-source-sans-3: No hairlines anywhere, so every stem in Bellota Text matches its curves. It makes a strong heading, while Source Sans 3 handles the quieter work, its open-bowled a keeping text modern and approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-spinnaker: Stitched-looking, steady, strangely friendly: that is Bellota Text, pressed with the same pen weight from first letter to last. Spinnaker takes over underneath, its modern sans apertures keeping counters linked to the space outside.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-stick: Stick draws tubelike lines of constant weight, with exits wide enough to let light through, under a heading in Bellota Text. Their shared openness is what holds them together.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-suse: Approachable and rounded, SUSE has bowls tipped open like a ladle, with curves as hefty as rope. Bellota Text above it brings the swagger, and its stroke-free shading makes the contrast feel deliberate.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-suse-mono: SUSE Mono gives every letter extra room on both sides, with open curves and clear gaps throughout. Under Bellota Text's constant-width headings, a long passage would move at a steady, unhurried walking pace.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tajawal: Distinctive from the first word, Bellota Text bends its strokes like cable, with no swelling or thinning anywhere. Tajawal supplies the quiet counterweight, its broad hooked c giving a plain sans some room.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tasa-explorer: TASA Explorer ends its curves like brush strokes lifted early, which gives the plain sans a soft, approachable finish. And Bellota Text's thread-stitched headings lead into it, so a long passage keeps moving without friction.
